observations.MEM-03: Next uses 768 KiB pipelined buffers; not whole archive allocation.
observations.MEM-04: Path ledgers cannot by themselves explain the RSS gap.
observations.MEM-05: Tree digest paths move into finalization map; no duplicate strings found.
observations.MEM-06: Thread-cap diagnostics16/32 show no convincing RSS win; no policy adopted.
observations.MEM-07: 34.07 MiB decoded data at DHAT global peak; necessary ownership, no leak established.
observations.MEM-08: Rayon contributes zero at the measured DHAT peak; remaining allocations alone do not justify a runtime change.
